🇮🇳🇳🇵 India & Nepal — Ayurveda & Rasoi Parampara

Bharatiya aur Nepali gharelu parampara me Adrak (ginger), Tulsi, Haldi (turmeric), Shahad (honey), Ajwain, Saunf aur Giloy jaise rasoi ingredients ka upyog sadiyon se mausami badlav, pachan aur gale ki dekhbhal me hota aaya hai.

🇯🇵🇨🇳🇰🇷 Japan, China & Korea — Kampo & Hanbang

East Asia ki paramparaon me Yuzu citrus tea, Naashpati (pear) ginger broth, aur acupressure points (jaise He Gu, Zu San Li, Yin Tang) ke madhyam se sharir ke santulan aur thakan door karne par zor diya jata hai.

🇬🇧🇩🇪🇺🇸 UK, Germany & USA — Herbal & Hausmittel

Western aur European gharelu paramparaon me Chamomile tisane, Peppermint steam, Thyme tea, Onion honey syrup (Hausmittel), aur warm salt water gargle ka istemal aam dekhbhal ke liye kiya jata hai.

Aam Sawal-Jawab (Most Asked Home Remedies FAQ)

Home remedies, acupressure points aur yoga mudras se jude sabse zaroori sawalon ke jawab

Parampara me sardi-khansi aur gale ki kharaash ke liye India me Adrak + Shahad + Tulsi, Japan me Adrak + Yuzu Chai, aur UK/USA me gunguna namak pani garara (saltwater gargle) aur honey-lemon tea apnaya jata hai. Saath hi He Gu Point aur Prana Mudra ki jaankari dekhein. (Note: 1 saal se chhote bachhon ko shahad na dein.)
Pachan aur gas-acidity ki samasya me Saunf + Jeera pani, halka Ajwain gunguna pani, ya Chamomile/Peppermint herbal tea parampara me lokpriya hai. Acupressure me Zu San Li Point aur mudraon me Vayu Mudra va Apana Mudra dekhein. Poora detail: Acidity & Gas Page.
Thakan aur sar dard me shant kamre me aaram, mathe par halka thanda patti ya chandan lep, aur Peppermint/Adrak chai parampara me use hoti hai. Acupressure ke liye haath par He Gu Point aur dono bhau ke beech Yin Tang Point sabse zyada search kiya jata hai. Detail: Sar Dard Page.
India aur Nepal me Amla + Bhringraj + Nariyal Tel ki halki malish, Korea/Japan me green tea aur scalp care, aur Western parampara me Rosemary pani rinse ka zikr milta hai. Mudraon me Prithvi Mudra ki jaankari dekhein: Hair Fall Guide.
Subah gunguna pani peena, raat ki bheegi kishmish ya munakka, fiber yukt aahar, aur Isabgol parampara me common hai. Acupressure me naabhi ke paas Tian Shu Point aur Apana Mudra dekhein: Kabz Remedies Page.
Sone se pehle screen se door rehna, gunguna doodh ya Chamomile/Lavender herbal tea peena, aur pairon ko gungune pani me rakhna neend ke liye paramparik upay hain. Shen Men Point aur Gyan Mudra bhi bahut lokpriya hain: Insomnia Page.
Neem patta, Gulab jal, taaza Aloe Vera gel, aur Multani Mitti twacha ki safai aur thandak ke liye parampara me use hote hain. Kisi bhi naye lep ko chehre par lagane se pehle haath par patch test zaroor karein. Dekhein: Acne Care aur 20 Ingredients Guide.
Hamesha aaramdayak aur halka dabav (1–2 minute) shant saans ke saath dein. Khule ghav, sujan, fracture ya pregnancy ke dauran bina doctor ki salah ke koi bhi point na dabayein. Sabhi 60 points yahan dekhein: All 60 Acupressure Points.
Yog parampara me Gyan, Prana, Apana, Vayu aur Surya Mudra subah ya shaam shant baithkar 10–15 minute tak aaram se ki jati hain. Agar haath ya ungliyon me dard ya chot ho to mudra na karein. Sabhi 42 mudrayein dekhein: All 42 Mudras.
Nahi, HomeRemediesWorld.com keval duniya ki parampara aur sanskritik jaankari deta hai—hum dawa nahi bechte aur ilaaj ka dawa nahi karte. Agar lakshan 2–3 din se zyada rahein, allergy ho, pregnancy ho, ya Heart Attack, Stroke, Cancer, TB jaise gambhir lakshan hon, to turant doctor ya hospital jayein.
